title: Karoline Leavitt at Her Worst: Lies and Abuse From the Podium
author: Team Zeteo
content:
No one has been a more relentlessly dishonest and verbally abusive mouthpiece
on behalf of Donald Trump and his authoritarian agenda than Karoline Leavitt.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

The White House Press Secretary in Trump's second term has attacked
journalists, defended the indefensible (Being friendly with pedophile Jeffrey
Epstein! Deporting Maryland father Kilmar Abrego Garcia!), and spouted absurd
lies about [Gaza condoms](https://zeteo.com/p/condoms-for-gaza-fact-checking-
trumps) and [DEI-induced plane crashes](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-blames-dc-
plane-crash-on-dei).

Now that Leavitt has announced [her departure](https://apnews.com/live/trump-
news-midterms-primaries-updates-08-12-2026) from the White House, we've
rounded up some of her most heinous moments from the podium, all in under two
minutes.
